A sole, exhausted spectre wonders deep into the Southern Forest. Tired as it was, the spectre hovered with purpose. There were more of his kind, those who had survived with senses intact, just a little further forward. Already he could sense their excitement, their imagination of their own future radiated outwards, creating an obvious trail for any others to follow.

Time passes...

Finally, the spectre wonders into a forest clearing. Awaiting him were a mass of confused spectres, sharing their thoughts with one another aimlessly. Using the power of the sun it stored on its journey, the spectre cast his voice into the crowd.

"Enough"

The thought rang through the minds of every Spectra in the clearing. At once, the scene fell to silence. All attention fell to the newcomer who had so rudely interrupted them.

"We have wasted enough time here as we speak, have you forgotten the gift of the traveler that will end us where we stand?"

A sense of dread spread amongst the Spectra as the weight of the words of the newcomer settled upon their minds. In the intoxicating experience of life they had forgotten the might of the moon, and it was already past mid-day.

"We waste time discussing the far future, of imagined greatness. There can be no future if we do not persist. There is much work to be done, for we must find shelter before the twin moons shine their gaze upon this part of Gaea."

The Spectra began to spread, seeking material to build an early settlement, a overhang to shield the newly united race from the heavens. As they dispersed, one spectrus posed a question to the newcomer. "What are you?"

"I am Luminus," The Newcomer replied as his cloak turned a brilliant white, "and I am nothing more or less than you." *****

Elsewhere, a spectre picked up a sword from the wreckage of a trade convoy. The spectre held the blade up so he could admire it. "This is a fine blade. May it shatter a thousand thousand minds and drive all who see it to madness." It remarked. He beckoned to a swarm of rabid spectres, clawing at thin air.

"Come my legion, there is a world to conquer, many minds to be broken."

The insane spectra gazed upon their leader, a being of impossible will, binding them all together with a mad, obsessed vision of grandeur and violence. Its crimson cloak, soaked in the blood of the traders, fluttering in the wind. It spoke, a few final words to signify their departure.

"So much to ruin, so little time."

The spectra floated into the shadows, leaving only the wreckage of the caravan in its wake.

Alright, I'm sure almost everybody has hit the character limit at some point and had to use clever tricks to try and fit everything in. I'm here to tell you there is a simple way around this. That is the CSS at-rule @import. Simply select a file host, upload your CSS document, then link to it on Voat. Like this:

@import url("DIRECT URL TO THE FILE HERE")

This should allow you to upload files that are as large as your new host will allow, while the Voat server only has to host that one line. If you combine this with external image hosts you're footprint on Voat's servers should be minimal! Here's an example of a sub functioning with this trick: /v/TemposPlaySpace

The only line on there right now is

@import url("https://a.uguu.se/upthzq_StevenUniverse.css")

(Warning, this will only last for a 24hrs since I'm only using a temporary host)

If any web-wizards see something I've missed let me know, I'm still learning.

Note

doing this will increase the total load time of the subverse (the first time your browser caches the external CSS). Make sure that the server hosting the CSS has good performance and uptime and is reliable.
[Tip] How to get around Voat's character limit while also saving atko bandwidth by hosting CSS externally
IIRC, your URL must be https:// or it won't work.
